The swing · Neither side · Both sides

The other two Cuttings pick an end of the track and dig in. Turnwise Wardens learned the track itself is the point — that the moment of crossing carries more than either end does, and that a needle sitting still is a needle doing nothing.

Whenever your needle crosses zero (moving from one side to the other), you gain Turn: a burst equal to your Wisdom modifier that you may spend as bonus damage, bonus healing, or extra radius/area on your next terrain-shaping spell before the end of your next turn.

7th — Both Hands: you ignore charge requirements up to 2 on either side.
15th — The Year in a Day: once per day, cross zero as a free action and treat the needle as simultaneously at full Green and full Grey for one spell.
